answer: The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Forge once and the fine is 3 times the stake, so a 210 POA proof becomes a 3x wound. Show me a cipher with a history, a quartz with a receipt, a nadir with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. One proof settles it, and it reads Merlin keeper hobby mark flown at the aerie, spelled out in full as each hobby is a measured quarry yield plus a falconer's signature. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
